title: How a Godly Man Leads the Group Chat Instead of Just Watching It
caption:
A godly man leads the group chat he didn't create. Nobody made him admin. He leads it anyway.

Someone sends a message that reads a little off and the thread keeps scrolling past it. He's the one who stops and texts, you good? He's the one who names what the thread is avoiding, even when it costs him the easy laugh. He's the one who turns we should get together into an actual day and time.

Leadership was never the title. It was who reached for the phone first.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #brotherhood #discipleship
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
